title: What If the Oceans Dropped 120 Meters? Britain Reconnects

scenes.text: What if the oceans dropped 120 meters? Britain would be joined to Europe again.
That is how low the sea sat at the peak of the last ice age, about 120 meters below today.
Between Britain and Europe lay Doggerland, a landscape about 23,000 square kilometers wide, mostly coastal marsh.
Fishing trawlers still drag up its tools. One barbed antler point came from 40 kilometers off Norfolk.
The sea came back slowly, at its fastest about one meter per century.
Britain was cut off around 6500 BCE. The old hunting grounds are still down there, under the North Sea.
